skills.name: Art
skills.description: Create works of art in a chosen medium — painting, sculpture, engraving.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Run, jump, and perform feats of agile movement.

skills.name: Animal Care
skills.description: Tend, calm, and treat the ailments of animals.

skills.name: Animal Training
skills.description: Train a kind of animal to obey commands and tricks.

skills.name: Bribery
skills.description: Grease palms to open doors that coin alone cannot.

skills.name: Channelling
skills.description: Draw a Wind of Magic to power the spells of one Lore.

skills.name: Charm
skills.description: Win others over with warmth, wit, and persuasion.

skills.name: Charm Animal
skills.description: Calm, soothe, or cow a beast without words.

skills.name: Climb
skills.description: Scale walls, cliffs, trees, and rigging.

skills.name: Consume Alcohol
skills.description: Hold your drink and shrug off its worst effects.

skills.name: Cool
skills.description: Keep your nerve under fear, pressure, and intimidation.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: Throw yourself clear of blows and hazards.

skills.name: Drive
skills.description: Handle a cart, carriage, or wagon and its team.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.description: Resist fatigue, poison, disease, and hardship.

skills.name: Entertain
skills.description: Hold an audience through a chosen kind of performance.

skills.name: Evaluate
skills.description: Judge the quality and worth of goods at a glance.

skills.name: Gamble
skills.description: Play the odds at cards, dice, and the wager.

skills.name: Gossip
skills.description: Trade rumours and tease information from idle talk.

skills.name: Haggle
skills.description: Negotiate better prices in trade and barter.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Treat wounds, disease, and poison; stop bleeding.

skills.name: Intimidate
skills.description: Cow others through threats and sheer presence.

skills.name: Intuition
skills.description: Trust your gut to sense that something is amiss.

skills.name: Language
skills.description: Speak and understand a chosen tongue.

skills.name: Leadership
skills.description: Rally, order, and inspire those who follow you.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Know a chosen field of knowledge in depth.

skills.name: Melee
skills.description: Fight in close combat with a chosen group of weapons.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.description: Find your way by map, star, and landmark.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Notice details, spot the hidden, and read a situation.

skills.name: Pick Lock
skills.description: Open locks without the key.

skills.name: Play
skills.description: Perform on a chosen musical instrument.

skills.name: Pray
skills.description: Invoke a deity for divine aid through prayer.

skills.name: Ranged
skills.description: Shoot or throw with a chosen group of ranged weapons.

skills.name: Research
skills.description: Dig facts out of libraries, archives, and learned folk.

skills.name: Ride
skills.description: Control and ride a chosen kind of mount.

skills.name: Row
skills.description: Propel and steer a rowed boat.

skills.name: Sail
skills.description: Crew and handle a sailing vessel.

skills.name: Secret Signs
skills.description: Leave and read the coded marks of a chosen group.

skills.name: Set Trap
skills.description: Build, place, and disarm snares and traps.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: Palm, pocket, and conceal small objects unseen.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Move unseen and unheard in a chosen kind of terrain.

skills.name: Swim
skills.description: Stay afloat and move through water, armour and all.

skills.name: Track
skills.description: Follow trails left by people and creatures.

skills.name: Trade
skills.description: Ply a chosen craft or trade for a living.
